unit_note: The frame figures in this file are f@60. RI-CMB03 is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from the S22 rebase (S22, orchestrator ruling R1): its 42 f pause was derived from a figure denominated in SECONDS (0.70 s) and was already correct. Rates per second and quantities of stamina are unit-invariant under a frame-base correction. Do not double anything here.

floor_provenance.label: constructed
floor_provenance.statement: THIS IS OURS, NOT SOULS'. No Souls game implements it. DS3 lets stamina go negative to -60 and both DS1 and DS3 gate on stamina > 0 — you may start an action you cannot afford and pay the debt afterwards. Our drop-the-input rule and hard 0.0 floor are a deliberate divergence, kept because a dropped input is a discrete assertable event in a trace and a debt is not. Any critic reading this file is entitled to score it as a divergence from Souls; what it must not be told is that it is Souls behaviour.

costs._note: Attack costs are the Stamina columns of frames.json (RI-CMB02 §A/§B) and are cross-referenced, not re-derived here.
costs.parry_is_flat_across_shield_classes: RI-CMB03 §B says 22 flat. An undeclared parry_medium_shield: 26 used to live here and, because the exemplar loadout carries the medium shield, it was the cost a player actually paid (W1-09 verdict §2.3). Removed; poise.json §criticals.parry.by_class[*].stamina is now 22 for every class.
costs.charged_when: in full, on the FIRST frame of the animation. Never spread across it (RI-CMB03 M3).

block.independence_rule: stability affects ONLY the stamina cost; absorption affects ONLY the damage. Conflating them is the classic error and RI-CMB03 M4 tests for it explicitly.

guard_break.trigger: a blocked impact that would take stamina below 0

declared_inversion_not_fixed.what: A medium stagger is 44 f@60 (RI-CMB05 §B, rebased) while a guard break is 40 f@60 (this block, S22-excluded). Shattering the guard therefore punishes LESS than being poked out of poise, which contradicts RI-CMB03 §D's own 'zero on a block is catastrophic'.
declared_inversion_not_fixed.recommendation_on_file: REBASE-S22-REPORT §7 recommends duration := 80 f@60 and riposte_window := [11, 68].
declared_inversion_not_fixed.why_this_build_did_not_act: Overriding an explicit exclusion in a seam ruling is the doctrine owner's call, not a builder's. This build implements 40 / [6,34] exactly as RI-CMB03 §D writes them and surfaces the inversion in the trace (both durations are emitted) so a critic can see it rather than having to find it.

zero_is_not_a_stagger: Reaching 0 stamina WITHOUT blocking does not stagger. Every stamina-consuming input is dropped until the bar recovers. Zero is fine; zero ON A BLOCK is catastrophic.

exhaustion.entry: stamina == 0.0 exactly, on any frame, by any spend
exhaustion.minimum_duration_derivation: 42 f delay + 36 / 0.75 = 90 f = 1.500 s at the exemplar 120 pool
exhaustion.guard_already_raised: may stay up, drains nothing, and ANY impact guard-breaks it
exhaustion.healing_rationale: exhaustion must not be a death sentence; it must be a bad situation with one expensive way out

representation_in_trace.decision: a BOOLEAN FIELD p.exhausted plus exhausted_enter / exhausted_exit events, NOT a value of p.state
representation_in_trace.why: RI-CMB07 §A's player state enum is CLOSED and fail-closed, and RI-CMB09 §6 asks for EXHAUSTED as a HARNESS.md §10 amendment. A state literally named EXHAUSTED would have to displace IDLE/WALK — but an exhausted player still walks, and RI-CMB09 §4 makes 'walk only' one of the state's defining properties, so collapsing them would delete the observation the item wants. The flag carries the same information, is measurable by RI-CMB09 M5 off exhausted_enter, and leaves RI-CMB07's enum closed. Declared here rather than done quietly.

distribution_targets._source: RI-CMB03 §E. These are consequences of the rules above, not independent knobs.
distribution_targets.frames_at_exactly_zero_note: band rebased by RI-CMB03 §E's own amendment (was 10-300); it is a frame count spanning wall clock that the stamina system did not rebase, so it must be re-measured rather than assumed
distribution_targets.inputs_dropped_rule: > 0 is MANDATORY. A fight where the bar never denies you has no economy.
